messages:
elaine: Heads-up — Neptune Systems signed an NDA and wants a 2-week POC to replace their current vendor. Main asks: parity with /v1/generate, pricing delta, and fallback behavior if our model differs. Can we triage?

samir: Congrats. What's their volume? Are they using streaming or sync?

elaine: Volume ~ 100 RPS peak, mostly sync. Some streaming for chat. They're strict on latency 100ms p95. They also run heavy prompt engineering so prompt parity matters.

carlos: 100ms p95 is tight. For adapter fallback we'd need dedicated capacity or fast-hosted variant. Can we propose canary: primary model = rdl-mk2-13b (quantized), fallback = rdl-mk1-13b (fp16) — fallback will be slightly slower but cheaper.

annie: On pricing — they asked about per-token + reserved capacity. If they move to Dedicated, we can give blended rate. I can draft numbers.

samir: Re: parity, we should capture sample prompts and expected outputs, run evals. If responses drift, we can add a response-normalization shim. Simple mapping example:
```
// pseudo-adapter
if (resp.contains("metadata")) resp = normalize(resp);
```

elaine: Is there an option to have automatic fallback when latency > 200ms? They want failover so UX degrades gracefully.

carlos: Yes — we can route by latency SLO. Policy example:
```
route(request) {
  attempt primary
  if (latency > 200ms || error) switch to fallback
}
```
But that adds tail overhead. Also need to surface in SLA and pricing (routing to fallback may bump tokens).

deploy-bot: CI deploy for adapter v0.3 succeeded on staging — logs in #eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:

annie: Security Qs — They want KMS integration and data residency. For Private, we can do VPC + customer KMS; for Hosted we provide configurable KMS with audit logs. I'll send SVC-Q answers.

samir: For POC, ask them to upload 100 representative prompts and expected outputs. We'll run A/B against their baseline and produce delta report (latency/cost/semantic similarity).

elaine: Can we commit to 2-week turnaround for POC? Also they want a price estimate for steady state 100 RPS.

annie: I can do an initial estimate: with Dedicated reserved pool, ballpark $X/day for capacity + per-token. I'll share a spreadsheet.

carlos: Heads-up: prompt parity work might require small retunes or prompt transformation — could be manual work. Need to flag engineering hours in proposal.

samir: I'll set up eval harness and run convergence tests. ETA 3 days after we get prompts.

elaine: Cool. Action items: @annie handle security answers + pricing sheet, @samir run evals + adapter prototype, @carlos scope fallback latency tradeoffs, I'll coordinate POC kickoff with Neptune.

annie: Got it. Sharing doc in 1 hour.

samir: Ping me once prompts are uploaded — I'll start.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Neptune wants kickoff Tues next week.
